The '''Pink Sky Casino''' was a [[Casino/Legends|casino]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. The [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Cabet Lom]] lived in the luxurious penthouse at the top of the building.<ref name="Scoundrel's Luck">''[[Scoundrel's Luck]]''</ref>
